name: -a
--all
options.description: Mount all filesystems mentioned in fstab

name: -F
--fork
options.description: Fork off for each device (use with -a)

options.name: --map-groups
options.description: Add the specified GID map to an ID-mapped mount

options.name: --map-users
options.description: Add the specified UID map to an ID-mapped mount

options.name: --options-mode
options.description: What to do with options loaded from fstab

options.name: --options-source-force
options.description: Force use of options from fstab/mtab

options.name: --onlyonce
options.description: Check if filesystem is already mounted

name: -O
--test-opts
options.description: Limit the set of filesystems (use with -a)

name: -r
--read-only
options.description: Mount the filesystem read-only (same as -o ro)

name: -t
--types
options.description: Limit the set of filesystem types

options.name: --target-prefix
options.description: Specifies path used for all mountpoints

name: -B
--bind
options.description: Mount a subtree somewhere else (same as -o bind)

name: -M
--move
options.description: Move a subtree to some other place

name: -R
--rbind
options.description: Mount a subtree and all submounts somewhere else

options.name: --make-rshared
options.description: Recursively mark a whole subtree as shared

options.name: --make-rslave
options.description: Recursively mark a whole subtree as slave

options.name: --make-rprivate
options.description: Recursively mark a whole subtree as private

options.name: --make-runbindable
options.description: Recursively mark a whole subtree as unbindable
